title: JA Essence EmDash 0.1.0: the template installs clean, every page family and the contact and subscribe forms work, nothing is requested from another origin before a click, and the shipped package carries its documented tools
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout, run the package's own tests from packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-essence (the package is not a workspace member; its dependencies are installed there with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile).

S2: Run run.cmd from run.cwd: the personalization tool on the template's real seed, the click-to-play video facade and slot roles, the source capture kept offline, the data link and link gate rules, the pager and category views, and the forms words.
S3: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The personalize tool run on the template's real seed with --no-model leaves no demo place, phone, address or company name of JA Essence in any field the template owns and keeps the customer's words.
The source capture blocks every request to another origin and lists it, and lets the font hosts through.
A link of the data that is empty or a hash is drawn without an address, never as a dead link; a page or an article of an unticked page answers 404.
The release tool refuses a package whose state carries a QA leftover (a form submission, a mail log row, a revision written after the seed).
evidence: Release cut of JA Essence 0.1.0 (19/11/2026): all 16 gates of tools/qa.mjs pass on the clean install of the package.
fence: The personalization tool, the offline source capture, the link gate and the state residue check that tools/release.mjs runs before packing the state

tests: the demo place is its proper names
withoutDemoPlace takes only the place phrase
the demo contacts come from the rules
with an address and no model
with no address: the demo address
with a model that gives nothing usable
visual-qa.mjs routes the source page offline
a state equal to a fresh seed has no residue
form submissions and the mail log a gate left are named
a revision written after the seed is named
the longest key alone lets a child outlive
the menu drops an unticked page
the header draws the menu through the gate
every place that renders the plugin form goes through FormWords
